sloka: नन्दिग्रामं गमिष्यामि सर्वानामन्त्रये ऽद्य व: ।तत्र दु:खमिदं सर्वं सहिष्ये राघवं विना ॥ २.११५.२॥
transliteration: nandigrāmaṁ gamiṣyāmi sarvānāmantraye 'dya va: ।tatra du:khamidaṁ sarvaṁ sahiṣye rāghavaṁ vinā ॥ 2.115.2॥

translations.english: I take leave of all of you. I am going to Nandigrama where I shall keep company with grief on account of Rama's absence.
